_comment: Release gates (ADR-006 §Release gates). All must PASS to publish. --gate evaluates the measurable rows against a run's receipt; --report-only downgrades a failing run to a non-zero-free advisory (used in CI until an ONNX embedder is present). A gate whose precondition does not apply to the run (e.g. OOS AUROC on the tickets suite, transfer regression with no --baseline-receipt) is SKIP, never a silent pass.
jev_reference_note: Jev's gen-0 (baseline) test_rows use the SAME gen0 criteria the local arm sends — apples-to-apples. The champion used mutated criteria whose examples are literal ticket texts (memorisation, ADR-004); it is reported as informational only.

accuracy_vs_jev.description: Local test accuracy within 3 pp of the Jev baseline (mean over Banking77/CLINC150/HWU64 in the full suite; department accuracy for tickets).

calibration_ece.description: Expected Calibration Error on test, 10 equal-width bins.

oos_auroc.description: Out-of-scope / noul AUROC on CLINC150 OOS; SKIP on suites without an OOS slice.

latency_native_p95.description: Native p95 per decision at concurrency 1 (bge-small INT8/FP32).

transfer_regression.description: Transfer-split accuracy must not regress beyond 1 pp vs the baseline receipt (ADR-004 gate 3); SKIP without --baseline-receipt.
